method: Chromium touch emulation with real CDP multi-touch, fault injection, complete checkpoint comparisons and offline requests blocked. Not physical iPhone/Android or Safari validation.

steps.name: portrait hideout matrix keeps controls readable and reachable
tap inventory transfers, native scroll and explicit grid placement
two trusted touch pointers move and fire together; release stops fire
rejected healing preserves the other thumb movement without consuming medicine
pointer cancellation and rotation never leave movement, fire or extraction held
loot pickup commits removal with inventory; checkpoint restores bullets and RNG
live backup round trip and failed medical transaction preserve consistent state
short landscape layout fits all active touch targets and map text remains readable
hold extraction is cancellable and successful settlement cannot restore the run
unsupported record stays untouched and original bytes can be exported
